text:
maya: FYI — ClipperCo (clipper-42) reported their daily usage CSV for 2026-03-09 is missing the 03:00-04:00 UTC slice. Dashboard shows ~12k tokens for that hour but the export file has zero rows. Manifest references files for the day but there's no hourly-03.csv in the bucket. Can someone triage?

sam: Which tenant path and ticket?

maya: Ticket #4521. S3 manifest: s3://redwood-exports/clipper-42/2026-03-09/manifest.json — customer attached a screenshot of the dashboard vs CSV.

kevin: quick note — had a small export-worker deploy at ~02:50 UTC. Could be a worker recycle race. :thinking:

anna: Checking ledger directly — DB shows tokens recorded for 03:00-04:00 (not zero). So this looks like an export/manifest gap, not missing billing rows.

kevin: digging into logs for export-worker around 02:58-03:02... found this repeated ERROR:
```
ERROR 2026-03-09T02:59:58Z export-worker shard=17 commit timeout: commit did not respond within 30s
stack: export/worker/commit.go:132
```
Looks like shard commit timed out during the deploy window.

sam: Do we have automatic retries/backfill for that window?

maya: Customer wants a backfill for that hour specifically. They'll hold on invoices until we confirm.

kevin: The backfill service normally picks up failed hours, but we had a skip condition for errors older than 48h and there was a concurrent manifest write. The retry entry exists but commit-mark is missing, so re-emit is needed.

sam: Proposal: run ad-hoc reemit for tenant clipper-42 for 02:00-04:00 UTC, regenerate hourly CSVs and update manifest. Ops needs to run in prod.

kevin: Command to run (ops):
```
# run from infra-tools box
./scripts/reemit_hourly.sh \ 
  --tenant clipper-42 \ 
  --from 2026-03-09T02:00:00Z \ 
  --to   2026-03-09T04:00:00Z \ 
  --dry-run=false
```
This will rebuild hourly CSVs and push new files + updated manifest. It also logs a commit mark for each shard.

ops-oncall: I'll run in staging first, then prod. ETA ~10m.

ops-oncall: running now in prod. tailing logs...

export-bot: manifest reemit started for clipper-42 2026-03-09 02:00-04:00 by ops-oncall

ops-oncall: reemit finished — hourly-03.csv created, manifest updated and uploaded. I pushed a new manifest version: s3://redwood-exports/clipper-42/2026-03-09/manifest.v12.json

export-bot: manifest updated and signed (v12) — signatures OK.

sam: Verified file present in bucket and checksum matches expected. Running quick reconcile:
```
SELECT hour_bucket, SUM(tokens) FROM ledger
 WHERE tenant_id='clipper-42' AND ts >= '2026-03-09' AND ts < '2026-03-10'
 GROUP BY hour_bucket ORDER BY hour_bucket;
```
For 03:00 bucket we get 12103 tokens. CSV row count for hourly-03.csv also 1 row with 12103 tokens.

maya: Notified customer; they confirmed CSV now shows the hour and their internal billing aligns.

anna: I'll open an incident (INC-2026-032) for RCA: likely root cause = export-worker shard commit timeout during deploy causing manifest to be written without the shard commit mark; backfill skip logic prevented immediate auto-retry. Action items: 1) change backfill skip threshold from 48h -> 1h for export workers, 2) add extra retry on commit timeout, 3) add an alert when manifest lists fewer hourly files than ledger indicates.

kevin: adding logs correlation check to postmortem: include deploy window and commit timeouts. Also will add a canary to exports during deploys.

maya: Customer is unblocked. I'm keeping ticket open until billing confirms invoice generation next cycle. Closing this thread when ticket closed. :thumbsup:
